name: button-group
behavior: Grouping container — role=group with an accessible name; each child keeps its own button semantics and its own tab stop. A roving-tabindex toolbar (APG toolbar) is a different pattern and a different component; grouping never changes the children's keyboard model.

parts.note: joins its children: inner radii collapse to 0, adjacent borders merge to a single hairline, and a focused child is raised above its neighbours so the focus ring is never clipped
hosts buttons (anatomy/button.json), toggles, or a select trigger; adds no recipe of its own — the children keep their emphasis/prominence/size
static affix segment (unit, prefix); non-interactive, excluded from the tab order
rule between sub-groups (anatomy/separator.json); orientation is the group's cross axis

anatomyNotes: Salt's nearest equivalent is SegmentedButtonGroup — the same join-the-children recipe over the same part list; Salt offers no vertical orientation, so a vertical group falls back per contract/variants.md §Fallback ladder. The size axis is deliberately absent: size belongs to the hosted buttons, and the group inherits it. Interaction states live on the children, never on the group.
